data.title: Sponsorship Opportunities
data.subtitle: Your support helps us create impactful opportunities for the next generation of data science and machine learning leaders.

data.text: Sponsoring the Data Science and Machine Learning Club (DSMLC) at the University of Calgary is more than just a partnership; it’s an investment in the future. Your sponsorship enables us to host educational workshops, engaging competitions, and valuable networking events. Together, we inspire innovation and empower students to make a difference in their academic and professional journeys.

data.header: We offer two unique sponsorship packages:

subheaders.text: Regular Program Club Activities Sponsorship Package

data.text: Sponsoring DSMLC presents a unique opportunity to engage with the next generation of data science and machine learning professionals. By partnering with us, sponsors will receive several benefits that enhance brand visibility, provide direct access to talent, and offer meaningful engagement with the data science community.

subheaders.text: Your company’s logo will be featured on event promotional materials, including posters, flyers, and social media, positioning your brand in front of a targeted group of students pursuing careers in data science and machine learning.

DSMLC members are some of the brightest and most driven students at the University of Calgary. As a sponsor, you will have opportunities to connect directly with students through our events, competitions, and workshops, providing access to potential interns and future employees.

By supporting DSMLC, your company demonstrates a commitment to advancing education and innovation in data science and machine learning. Your sponsorship directly contributes to developing future professionals equipped to tackle real-world challenges.
Sponsors are invited to attend DSMLC events, where they can engage with students and professionals, fostering valuable connections within the academic and data science communities.

Higher-tier sponsorships include exclusive opportunities, such as speaking engagements, event MC roles, and recognition in opening and closing ceremonies, allowing your company to stand out as a leader in supporting student education and professional growth.

data.header: Regular Program Club Activities Sponsorship Package
data.text: Support DSMLC’s year-round workshops, socials, and competitions. This package includes a variety of events such as skills workshops, internship nights, and our innovative Visionary Lab initiative. Be part of shaping future talent and making data science accessible to all students.

Make a lasting impact by supporting our marquee event of the year! The Annual Final Competition brings students, academia, and industry together for a showcase of talent, innovation, and creativity. This sponsorship aligns your brand with excellence and provides unique engagement opportunities.
We are grateful to our sponsors for their invaluable support. Your logo could be here!
We love hearing from our sponsors about their experiences working with DSMLC. If you’ve partnered with us before, we’d love to feature your testimonial!
